component.name: Cordn Coordinator
component.summary: Run your own Cordn MLS delivery coordinator

description.p: Self-hosted ContextVM/MCP MLS delivery coordinator over Nostr relays. Publishes your coordinator Nostr identity (npub / nprofile + QR), stores MLS key packages, welcomes, join requests, and opaque per-group message streams in local SQLite storage, and streams messages to group members.
